scripts.logs: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dir='org.fivenet.streamdeck-plugin.sdPlugin\logs'; $last=@{ }; while($true){ $f=Get-ChildItem $dir\*.log | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if($f -and $last[$f.FullName] -ne $f.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks){ Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Tail 100 -Encoding UTF8; $last[$f.FullName]=$f.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700 }"
